data.name: Devil Typocrypha: aLt-ESChatopia - Card x Command Active Typing Battle DRPG
data.detailed_description:
A Typing Card Battle D-RPG with ‹NO ALTERNATIVE›.

Collect Cards. Command Demons. Control Keys.

Chronicle the City’s Curse as a Devil Archivist.

Raise and customize parties in your own strategy to expel evils in hybrid turn-based typing action.

‹Dispel› the ‹Distortions› of ‹Desire› and ‹Decay›.

Play as the Devil Archivist Wyoming, a demon summoner tasked with recording occult phenomena for the United Nations. Delve into the Sagara Underground City to solve the mystery of a demon outbreak in a cyberpunk alternate history. With many weapons and demon allies to choose from, use your typing skills to make contracts with the paranormal and battle Anomalous Lifeforms in hybridized action turn-based card combat!

Synopsis

An occult noise begins to drone, deep within the Pacific Ocean: a hum heralding the advent of disaster. 

The Sagara Underground City bears witness to the curse of an unknown force that victims can only describe as an ‹Evil Eye›. The anomalous phenomenon warps the minds and lands to disorder. Demons are drawn out from the dark. Humans are driven to blood in madness. They cross and consume one another alike in wanton violence. 

An incident begins as those in the shadows respond to the unprecedented spiritual threat.

Features

  • Unparalleled CCATB Combat
    A "New-Type" RPG where action-based Cards create combo attack chains and end with a turn-based Command Finisher.

  • Dynamic Character Progression Systems
    This is a RPG with no EXP. Gain stats over time by fighting stronger enemies and performing well at typing. Devil Archivist Yomi can make use of Swords, Guns, Martial Arts, Divine, Profane, PSI, and Beyond Magic to create an emergent playstyle all your own.

  • Typing Negotiations
    Make contracts with over 100 different demons to gain powerful allies in battle and in dungeon exploration. Type your responses before demons grow impatient. Typing performance, character stats and varied personalities create dynamic dialogue challenges mid-battle.

  • Demon Customization
    Merge demons to summon more powerful allies with new Card attack strings. Alternatively, have your demons devour enemies to grow stronger and assimilate their abilities & Cards as your own.

  • Immersive 1st Person Grid Dungeons
    Explore the depths of the ‹Sagara Underground City› through classic 1st dungeon crawling maps, expanded and refined for a modern audience.

  • An "Alternative" Story of ‹Digital Devils› set in an Occult-Cyberpunk World
    Featuring a "Denpa" storyline where spirituality fades into the drowning noise of voltage and steel.

  • An Experience Crafted With Human Hands Alone
    A game that features art and music produced by a single developer without the usage of generative AI.

content_descriptors.notes: Devil Typocrypha: aLt-ESC features imagery that invokes blood, violence, and the occult. Battles have particle effects that occasionally includes blood splatter. Ally & enemy roster consists of a range of figure from real mythologies and folklore that may invoke mature content in theming.
